# Sherwood Property Solutions

Sherwood Property Solutions Ltd buys land for residential development
across Nottingham and the East Midlands, and has been doing so since
2014. Run by Ryan Taylor. We buy sites from single building plots and
garden plots up to larger development sites, with or without planning
permission.

How we work: we value land using the residual land value method (the
industry standard) and always show the seller the full breakdown of how
we reached our offer. Initial assessment within 48 hours, detailed offer
in 5 to 7 working days. There are no fees and no obligation at any
stage, and we can work alongside your estate agent if you are already
listed. Most purchases complete within 8 to 12 weeks.

Contact: 01158 716 385, via https://www.sherwoodproperty.co.uk
